data.content_ref: inline:The §11.3 flag is an *artifact of temporal misalignment*: the 'sound and relevant' affirmations (SRC_006, SRC_008) and the 'failed' verdicts (SRC_007, SRC_009) were computed at different evaluation rounds against different versions of claim 0c61961a8085. The covering principle is *snapshot divergence*: the ritual compares verdicts that were never co-temporal, so the flag is sustained not by any deep structural reason but by a bookkeeping failure to pin all adjudications to the same immutable claim version. The ritual will continue to flag until the harness enforces atomic co-evaluation.
